summary: Account Payable Role Center in Business Central (2025 release wave 2): a role center that gathers purchase documents, incoming e-documents, payments, approvals, Power BI reports and payable charts in one place. The video says it will be available in 27.1, from November.
overview:
The video introduces a new Account Payable Role Center that centralizes workflow management for account payable processes. Purchase documents, e-documents and payments from several sources are brought into one place, so payable teams can focus on a single location for their operations.

A short demo covers the activities in the role center, including ongoing purchase orders, incoming e-documents, payment documents, approvals and intercompany processes. It also shows Power BI reports for purchase and account payable, and charts such as top five vendors, payable performance, overdue documents and age analysis. The presenter states availability as 27.1, from November.
key_points: The Account Payable Role Center centralizes workflow management for purchase documents, e-documents, payments and approvals.
Availability stated in the video: 27.1, which means from November.
The role center focuses on ongoing purchase documents and the incoming part of e-documents only.
Power BI reports related to purchase and account payable are available directly in the role center.
Payable insights include vendor information, overdue documents, payable performance and age analysis.
One chart shows top five vendors, and there are four different charts you can switch between.
Payment documents, approvals and intercompany processes are accessible from the role center.
